subject: Money
title: Spending on Experiences
description: A quick win: understand Spending on Experiences.

hook.text: Cornell research shows experiences make us happier than things. A trip beats a TV at every time horizon.

buildup.text: Experiences integrate into identity. You are your adventures, not your appliances.

discovery.text: Experiences improve with retelling. Memories get better over time. Objects depreciate physically and emotionally.

twist.text: Even bad experiences become good stories. That terrible camping trip is now your funniest dinner tale.

climax.text: Shifting spending from things to experiences is the highest-ROI financial move for happiness.

quiz.question: Why do experiences make us happier than things?
